description: This file contains R functions related to Spark SQLContext operations, including schema inference, SparkSession management, reading data from various sources (JSON, ORC, Parquet, text, JDBC), creating DataFrames, and executing SQL queries within Spark.

methods.name: getInternalType
methods.description: Maps R data types to Spark SQL types.

methods.name: infer_type
methods.description: Infers Spark SQL data type from R object.

methods.name: sparkR.version
methods.description: Returns the Spark version as a string.

methods.name: createDataFrame
methods.description: Creates a Spark DataFrame from R data structures.

methods.name: toDF
methods.description: Converts an RDD to a Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: tableToDF
methods.description: Loads a Spark SQL table/view as a DataFrame.

methods.name: read.json
methods.description: Reads a JSON file into a Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: read.orc
methods.description: Reads an ORC file into a Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: read.parquet
methods.description: Reads a Parquet file into a Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: read.text
methods.description: Reads a text file into a Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: sql
methods.description: Executes a SQL query in Spark.

methods.name: read.df
methods.description: Reads data from various sources into a Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: read.jdbc
methods.description: Reads a table from a JDBC source into a Spark DataFrame.

methods.name: read.stream
methods.description: Reads streaming data into a Spark DataFrame.
